name: mitsuketa-zukan-native
description: Native wrapper for わたしの図鑑ライブラリ

scripts.native:prepare: npm run build:native && npx cap sync
scripts.native:ios:add: npm run build:native && npx cap add ios
scripts.native:ios:open: npm run native:prepare && npx cap open ios
scripts.native:android:add: npm run build:native && npx cap add android
scripts.native:android:open: npm run native:prepare && npx cap open android
